override.title: Admin Override
override.hint: Overrides are always logged with your admin identity and reason - never silent.
override.cancelBookingHint: Cancelling marks the booking and its commission as cancelled, returns operational ownership to the partner, and lets the builder book this lead again.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Cancel this booking? Its commission is cancelled too. This is logged with your name and reason.

detail.disputeOpen: An ownership dispute is open on this customer - another partner says it is theirs. It is decided on the Disputes page.

cancellation.title: Booking cancelled
cancellation.hint: The booking and its commission are cancelled; operational ownership is back with the partner and the builder can book this lead again.

disputes.title: Ownership Disputes
disputes.hint: A partner whose registration was rejected as a duplicate can dispute who owns the customer. Review both sides and decide.

detail.title: Dispute {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: The held registration could not be found.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} keeps the customer. The dispute is closed and nothing else changes.
detail.overturnEffect: {{holder}}'s duplicate protection ends now and the customer is registered for {{partner}} as a new registration.
detail.heldBookedHelp: This customer is booked through the current owner. Cancel that booking first (Admin Override on the registration), then overturn:
